Lenticulizer runtime notices

Lenticulizer includes Microsoft .NET 10 and Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime
152.0.4191.62 (Fixed Version), with their accompanying license and third-party
notices. Use of the bundled Microsoft components is subject to those terms.

Microsoft WebView2 may collect diagnostic data as described in its license and
Microsoft privacy statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
The application does not add analytics or upload your source images.

The complete WebView2 Runtime license is in WebView2-Runtime-License.html.
.NET license and notices are in DotNET-LICENSE.TXT and
DotNET-THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT. WebView2 SDK notices are included beside this file.
The browser folder also contains the unmodified Microsoft and Chromium notices.

Bundled runtime versions are updated with Lenticulizer releases. No runtime
installer or runtime download is needed to launch this build.
